series.name: monthly mean 2 m air temperature, Frankfurt am Main (NASA POWER, 50.11 N, 8.68 E)
series.note: Data end in 2025-12 because the POWER monthly load covers whole years.

kpss_level.note: seasonally adjusted training series (month means removed); p-value interpolated from the KPSS table, bounded in [0.01, 0.10]

mann_kendall_annual.note: annual means 1981-2022; corrected variant uses the Hamed-Rao variance adjustment

trend.note: Associations with calendar time (OLS, Newey-West/HAC errors), not causal effects.

seasonal_cycle_drift_training.note: annual harmonic with linearly drifting coefficients; joint HAC Wald test of both drift terms

selection.rule: D=1 if STL seasonal strength > 0.64; d by KPSS; p,q<=3,P,Q<=2 stepwise AICc

sarima_full.model: SARIMA(1, 0, 1)x(0, 1, 1)[12] with constant (refit on all periods)

harmonic_trend_full.model: linear trend + 2 annual harmonic(s), OLS (refit on all periods)

dm_vs_seasonal_naive.note: positive mean_loss_diff = model has lower loss than seasonal naive; HLN-corrected, t(35); Bartlett long-run variance with truncation h=12 (seasonal cycle) or h=1
positive mean_loss_diff = model has lower loss than seasonal naive; HLN-corrected, t(35); Bartlett long-run variance with truncation h=12 (seasonal cycle) or h=1

naive.note: positive mean_loss_diff = model has lower loss than seasonal naive; HLN-corrected, t(35); Bartlett long-run variance with truncation h=12 (seasonal cycle) or h=1

ets_ana.note: positive mean_loss_diff = model has lower loss than seasonal naive; HLN-corrected, t(35); Bartlett long-run variance with truncation h=12 (seasonal cycle) or h=1

ets_aada.note: positive mean_loss_diff = model has lower loss than seasonal naive; HLN-corrected, t(35); Bartlett long-run variance with truncation h=12 (seasonal cycle) or h=1

sarima.note: positive mean_loss_diff = model has lower loss than seasonal naive; HLN-corrected, t(35); Bartlett long-run variance with truncation h=12 (seasonal cycle) or h=1

harmonic_trend.note: positive mean_loss_diff = model has lower loss than seasonal naive; HLN-corrected, t(35); Bartlett long-run variance with truncation h=12 (seasonal cycle) or h=1

rolling_origin.note: Origins overlap (36-month horizon, annual spacing): errors are not independent. Used for horizon and season skill, not for model choice of the frozen setup.

h1_result.test: OLS/HAC linear trend of annual mean T2M on year, training years 1981-2022
h1_result.note: association with calendar time, not a causal effect

h2_result.test: hold-out and rolling-origin RMSE/MASE of non-naive models relative to seasonal naive
h2_result.note: ratio < 1 = model better than seasonal naive; DM p-values in dm_tests

h3_result.test: pairwise Diebold-Mariano (squared error, HLN, h=12) of ETS/SARIMA against harmonic_trend on the hold-out
